units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:7">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 7</cite> <he>והת׳ שלו</he> R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 23:2">Kel. XXIII, 2</cite> (ed. <he>תופס</he>, <he>תופו׳</he>; v. <cite ref="V00805"><he>תָּפוּס</he></cite>) and the attachment to it (the saddle).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 23:2">Ib.</cite> <he>זרז … והת׳</he> the Ashkelonian belt … and the saddle (<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 23:2">Kel. XXIII, 2</cite> <he>ועביט של גמל</he>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 23:3">Kel. XXIII, 3</cite> <he>ת׳ של חמור</he> the saddle of a sumpter-ass (consisting of a wooden frame).—Pl. <he>תָּפִיּוֹת</he>. Tosef. l. c. <he>ושאר כל ת׳ שבצדדין</he> and all other attachments (straps &c.) hanging down the sides of the beast of burden.
